title: sorbus torminalis f. kissii
intro: Sorbus torminalis f. kissii, commonly known as Chinese Rowan or Korean Rowan, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as inflammation, fever, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Sorbus torminalis f. kissii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
